control_p2replay_reason: Control@24576 was trained with on-policy PPO (not P2 Replay). There is no Control+P2Replay arm. Therefore Control cannot serve as a strict same-training-method reference for the P2Replay arms. The Control comparison in this report measures the combined effect of (W512 architecture + P2 Replay training) vs (base GTrXL + PPO training), not the isolated effect of W512 long memory under replay.
